title: Aggregate data and research software for Hi. I'm Molly, Your Virtual Interviewer!
description: Aggregate results and executable scoring, statistical analysis and plotting code for a 218-participant virtual-interviewer study. Includes historical reproduction and a separately labelled corrected scoring companion. Participant-level records are excluded.
